subject_scope: Frozen Knight field only; 12 corrected C1-primary regular d8 root cells. This is local research evidence, not a full Knight witness or product pass.
root_selection: exact 12 records with primary_handoff=true and c1_v2_state!=UNKNOWN from the corrected C1 V2 profile
metrics: surface-present root count at each depth/contourer
direct float64 field residual at emitted vertices
d11/d12 convergence toward d13 local MC reference as a diagnostic only
reference_boundary: d13 local MC is an approximation reference only, never truth or certificate.

interpretation.DEPTH_DOMINANT: normalized residual and local reference discrepancy improve strongly with depth while MC-vs-MTet differences remain smaller than the depth effect
interpretation.CONTOURER_MATERIAL: same-depth MC-vs-MTet discrepancy or direct residual difference is comparable to or larger than the d11->d12 depth effect on multiple surface-present roots
interpretation.LOCAL_SAMPLING_INSUFFICIENT: d13 still has large direct normalized residual or unstable surface presence/components

claim_boundary: X1 chooses the next engineering emphasis only. It cannot promote a product extractor, claim full-domain coverage, or replace VF11/Stage13 source-fidelity gates.
